winter_steps:
Read the TPWD rule in the notes first.
Whatever you decide, never pour the water or plants into a drain, ditch, creek or pond. Bag and bin the plants, or let them dry out completely.
If keeping it is allowed, move it indoors before the first night under 45 F to a warm bright window (65-75 F) with a grow light.

notes: Texas Parks and Wildlife lists water hyacinth among harmful or potentially harmful exotic aquatic plants. Its rules make it unlawful to possess or transport listed plants without a permit and do not mention an exception for home or ornamental containers. Check with TPWD before keeping it. Source: https://tpwd.texas.gov/regulations/outdoor-annual/fishing/general-rules-regulations/possession-and-transport-of-exotic-aquatic-species
